transitHacks.title: 🎫 Daily Cap & 16-25 Railcard Hack
transitHacks.desc: Hit the Zone 1-2 daily cap (£8.90 on contactless/Oyster) and all subsequent rides cost £0.00. Link a 16-25 National Railcard to a physical Oyster card for 34% off off-peak fares and caps.

transitHacks.title: ✈️ Airport Transfer Hacks
transitHacks.desc: Skip the pricey Gatwick Express; take standard Southern or Thameslink trains from the same platform with contactless. Book National Express buses to Stansted or Luton weeks ahead for £5.

transitHacks.title: 🚌 £1.75 Hopper Fare & Night Buses
transitHacks.desc: Your £1.75 bus fare includes unlimited bus transfers within 60 minutes. On night buses (N-series), sit on the lower deck near the driver for better safety.
